description: Fixed synthetic development cohort for the full LLGM.answer retrieval, Python node-delegate and final-synthesis pipeline. Each case runs in an isolated workspace. Node labels and expected answers are evaluator-only; the runner maps labels to opaque UUIDs and supplies only source text, curated edges, explicit overwrite patches and the question/scope/time to LLGM. Nodes each contain one user turn named note. Patches are appended in listed order and replace the exact unique subject_text with the replacement node's complete note. Curated relationships isolate inference from learned maintenance. These small cases do not establish benchmark quality, independent generalization, or recursive delegation unless the retained trace shows it. Answer-field string checks and required citation labels are diagnostic checks rather than an independent entailment judgment. CONFLICT and UNKNOWN are explicit answer-format conventions for the two abstention cases.
